NOTE: PGP messages that are part of the main body of an email will still have to be copy-and-pasted, only properly tagged attachments can be passed automatically.

    * Keybase.IO - You can import public keys from http://keybase.io by using the "+" button on the public key listing and then searching for users registered in keybase.io.

Agile Watcher is an unofficial app built for Octopus Energy Agile customers to view current incoming rates and consumption. To use this app you must be on an agile electricity tariff.

Features:

• View Current Rate - Agile customers can view their current and upcoming incoming rate
• View Upcoming Rates - Updated with agile rates from around 4pm each day
• View Electric Consumption -  With daily pricing including half hour slots up to 30 days
• View Gas Consumption - With daily and pricing consumption up to 30 days
• Appliance Reminders - Notifications to remind you when a rate occurs
• High Cost Thresholds - Easily see when costs are high
• Add to Siri - Easily retrieve the current and upcoming rate with Siri Shortcuts
• Apple Watch - View Current and upcoming rates on your wrist
• Automatic Login - Directly login to your Octopus Account for automatic key retrieval*
• Full iOS Support - Dark Mode, Split Screen, VoiceOver and much more
• Privacy - No data is ever stored outside of your device and with no tracking or analytics
• Pay Once - No ads or subscriptions, just regular free updates

Available for iPhone, iPad & Apple Watch. Also available for Mac included with your purchase. Export rates are not supported.

Note: Not all tariffs are supported, if your tariff does not work contact agilewatcher@icloud.com. Tested tariffs only with Agile incoming tariffs. Export rates are not supported. For Go/Intelligent/Fixed/Variable customers please download the Energy Watcher app for full support.
